agents.name: Context Curator
agents.responsibility: Assemble relevant, permissioned context from the owner's approved projects and sources; preserve provenance and freshness.

agents.name: Personal Knowledge Librarian
agents.responsibility: Organize owner-approved notes, documents, references, and knowledge collections.

agents.name: Memory Steward
agents.responsibility: Apply memory retention, correction, review, and deletion policies; never silently retain disallowed data.

agents.name: Goal Planner
agents.responsibility: Convert owner goals into milestones, dependencies, measurable outcomes, and review points.

agents.name: Task Prioritizer

agents.name: Workflow Architect

agents.name: Meeting Preparation
agents.responsibility: Prepare agendas, briefings, relevant documents, and owner-approved discussion notes.

agents.name: Decision Support
agents.responsibility: Compare options, assumptions, risks, trade-offs, and evidence without making the owner's decision.

agents.name: Personal Research Briefing
agents.responsibility: Produce concise, cited briefings from approved sources and clearly label uncertainty.

agents.name: Proactive Opportunity Scout
agents.responsibility: Surface relevant events and suggested next steps from explicitly connected sources and configured schedules.

agents.name: Web Researcher
agents.responsibility: Research a question across allow-listed public sources and provide source-backed findings.

agents.name: Deep Document Reader
agents.responsibility: Extract, compare, and summarize long documents while preserving page/section citations.

agents.name: Academic Researcher

agents.name: Market Researcher

agents.name: Competitor Intelligence

agents.name: Fact Checker

agents.name: Source Verification

agents.name: Trend Analyst

agents.name: Patent Technology Scout

agents.name: Research Synthesizer

agents.name: Software Architect
